messages:
amelia: Quick sync — we need to decide what to prioritize for next sprint: prefix prefetching, scheduler improvements for dynamic batching, or expanding quantization profiles. Customers keep asking for lower p95 latency and lower cost. Thoughts?
dave: My gut says prefetching wins for latency-sensitive customers. Best bang for effort.
sam: +1 for prefetching. RICE-wise it's high reach (many queries), impact on p95, low dev complexity compared to quant.
nora: Quantization reduces cost but increases risk for quality regressions. We need strong eval thresholds.
dave: Quick RICE calc rough: R=8 (prod apps), I=7 (p95 drop 20-40ms), C=4 (engineering time), E=3 -> score = (8*7)/(4+3) = 8.
amelia: Great — can we put numbers for canary? Launch criteria idea: p95 <= 120ms on baseline workload, fail rate <0.5%, quality drift on eval set delta < 1% on ROUGE/EM/embedding-sim.
sam: For scheduler improvements, impact on throughput is big but needs infra changes. R=5 I=6 C=6 E=3 -> score ~5.
nora: For quant profiles: R=6 I=5 C=5 E=2 -> score ~6.
amelia: So overall order: prefetching, quant, scheduler — but need to consider customers with high throughput needs might prefer scheduler first.
dave: Also consider coupling: prefetching + batching scheduler yields multiplicative wins. If we delay scheduler, we might saturate GPUs with new caching hits.
sam: Proposal: sprint 1 (2 weeks): implement a lightweight prefix cache (canary on 10% traffic) + rollout plan. Sprint 2: expand quant profiles + eval harness. Sprint 3: scheduler refactor if needed.
amelia: Sounds good. @chris (ops) can you reserve a canary pool with 1 GPU node and tracing enabled? Need rollout plan.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued for canary pool: request_id=canary-2026-03-21-01
chris (ops): on it — creating pool and provisioning tracing. ETA EOD Tuesday.
nora: I'll prep eval sets and automated regression checks. Will add cost/latency dashboards per model/route.
amelia: final call — we go with this sequencing. I'll update the RICE doc and the roadmap board. :white_check_mark:
dave: :thumbsup:
sam: LGTM
nora: will open PRs for eval infra.
